The Group invests extensive
resources (both human and
technological) in strengthening
its information security and cyber
defense system, in order to cope with
the development of these threats.

Cyber risk is the risk
of damage, including
disruption, disturbance,
shut down of operations,
theft of property, collection
of intelligence, or damage
to reputation or the
confidence of the public as
a result of a cyber event.
